<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Plaid Maker</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Mono:wght@300;400;500&family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --bg:         #f0ede8;
  --surface:    #faf9f7;
  --surface2:   #f4f1ec;
  --border:     #e0dbd2;
  --border-md:  #ccc6bb;
  --text:       #1a1714;
  --muted:      #8a8278;
  --accent:     #c4472a;
  --accent-h:   #a83820;
  --accent2:    #2a6ec4;
  --green:      #2a7a45;
  --nav-bg:     #1a1714;
  --nav-text:   #ffffff;
  --nav-text-dim: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  --nav-text-bright: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  --nav-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  --nav-btn-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  --nav-btn-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
  --nav-btn-hover-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
  --sel-highlight:  #eef3fd;
  --sel-dot-hover-bg: #d0e2f8;
  --radius:     3px;
  --sidebar-w:  252px;
  --nav-h:      48px;
  --shadow:     0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.07), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  --shadow-lg:  0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
}

html[data-theme="grey"] {
  --bg:         #3d3935;
  --surface:    #4a4540;
  --surface2:   #524d48;
  --border:     #5d5854;
  --border-md:  #6d6860;
  --text:       #f0ede8;
  --muted:      #b5aca0;
  --accent:     #e8653f;
  --accent-h:   #ff7c52;
  --accent2:    #4a8ee6;
  --green:      #4a9a5f;
  --nav-bg:     #2d2926;
  --nav-text:   #f0ede8;
  --nav-text-dim: rgba(240,237,232,0.4);
  --nav-text-bright: rgba(240,237,232,0.75);
  --nav-border: rgba(240,237,232,0.1);
  --nav-btn-bg: rgba(240,237,232,0.08);
  --nav-btn-border: rgba(240,237,232,0.14);
  --nav-btn-hover-bg: rgba(240,237,232,0.16);
  --sel-highlight:  #5d5854;
  --sel-dot-hover-bg: #6d6860;
  --shadow:     0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  --shadow-lg:  0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}

html[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg:         #1a1714;
  --surface:    #252220;
  --surface2:   #2d2926;
  --border:     #3d3935;
  --border-md:  #4a4540;
  --text:       #f0ede8;
  --muted:      #9d8f7f;
  --accent:     #e8653f;
  --accent-h:   #ff7c52;
  --accent2:    #4a8ee6;
  --green:      #4a9a5f;
  --nav-bg:     #0d0b09;
  --nav-text:   #f0ede8;
  --nav-text-dim: rgba(240,237,232,0.4);
  --nav-text-bright: rgba(240,237,232,0.75);
  --nav-border: rgba(240,237,232,0.1);
  --nav-btn-bg: rgba(240,237,232,0.08);
  --nav-btn-border: rgba(240,237,232,0.14);
  --nav-btn-hover-bg: rgba(240,237,232,0.16);
  --sel-highlight:  #3d3935;
  --sel-dot-hover-bg: #4a4540;
  --shadow:     0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  --shadow-lg:  0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}

body {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  min-height: 100%;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* ── NAV ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
nav {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 400;
  height: var(--nav-h);
  background: var(--nav-bg);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.nav-brand {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  height: 100%;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--nav-border);
}
.nav-brand-name {
  font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--nav-text);
  letter-spacing: .01em;
}
.nav-brand-name em { font-style: italic; color: #e8c9a0; }
.nav-info {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  flex: 1;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--nav-border);
}
.nav-stat {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .62rem;
  color: var(--nav-text-dim);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
}
.nav-stat b { color: var(--nav-text-bright); font-weight: 500; }
.nav-dot { width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--nav-border); }

/* ── WORKSPACE ───────────────────────────────────── */
.workspace {
  display: flex;
  height: calc(100vh - var(--nav-h));
  margin-top: var(--nav-h);
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ── SIDEBAR ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.sidebar {
  width: var(--sidebar-w);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* section */
.sec {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.sec-hd {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0;
  padding: 0 14px;
  height: 34px;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  background: var(--surface2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  transition: background .1s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sec-hd:hover { background: var(--bg); }
.sec-icon {
  width: 16px; height: 16px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-right: 8px; flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.sec-label {
  font-size: .6rem; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted); flex: 1;
}
.sec-badge {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .58rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  margin-right: 7px;
}
.sec-chevron {
  font-size: 8px; color: var(--border-md);
  transition: transform .15s; line-height: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sec.collapsed .sec-chevron { transform: rotate(-90deg); }

.sec-body {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 2000px;
  transition: max-height .22s ease, padding .18s ease, opacity .15s;
  opacity: 1;
}
.sec.collapsed .sec-body {
  max-height: 0; padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 0;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden;
}
.sec.scrollable .sec-body {
  overflow-y: visible;
  max-height: 2000px;
}
.sec.collapsed.scrollable .sec-body { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }

/* ── STICKY PROGRESS BAR ─────────────────────────── */
.sec-sticky-bar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 20;
  background: var(--surface);
  padding: 8px 12px 6px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.sec-sticky-bar .thread-progress-wrap {
  margin-top: 0;
}
.sec-sticky-bar .seq-warn {
  margin-top: 0;
  padding-top: 0;
  padding-bottom: 0;
  padding-left: 7px;
  padding-right: 7px;
  max-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-width: 0;
  transition: max-height .15s ease, margin-top .15s ease, padding .15s ease, border-width .15s;
}
.sec-sticky-bar .seq-warn.visible {
  max-height: 40px;
  margin-top: 7px;
  padding-top: 4px;
  padding-bottom: 4px;
  border-width: 1px;
}
.sec.collapsed .sec-sticky-bar {
  display: none;
}

/* ── PALETTE ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.pal-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3px; }
.pal-row  { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }

.hex-wrap {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0;
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-md); border-radius: var(--radius);
  overflow: hidden; height: 26px;
  background: var(--surface);
  transition: border-color .1s;
}
.hex-wrap:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent2); }
.hex-in {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: none; outline: none;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: .65rem;
  padding: 0 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.nat-wrap {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0; cursor: pointer;
}
.nat-wrap .sw {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.nat-wrap input[type=color] {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%; cursor: pointer; border: none;
}
.bx {
  background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--border-md); padding: 2px 3px;
  border-radius: 2px; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1;
  transition: color .1s; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.bx:hover { color: var(--accent); }

.add-pal { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.new-sw {
  width: 26px; height: 26px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-md); border-radius: var(--radius);
  cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; position: relative; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.new-sw .sw { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.new-sw input[type=color] {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%; cursor: pointer; border: none;
}
.btn-ghost {
  flex: 1; height: 26px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-md); border-radius: var(--radius);
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: .62rem; font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px;
  transition: all .1s;
}
.btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent2); color: var(--accent2); background: #eef3fd; }

/* ── SETTINGS ────────────────────────────────────── */
.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.field-lbl {
  font-size: .58rem; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);
}
.field-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.num-in {
  height: 26px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-md); border-radius: var(--radius);
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: .7rem;
  text-align: center; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text);
  transition: border-color .1s;
}
.num-in:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent2); }
.sel-in {
  width: 100%; height: 26px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-md); border-radius: var(--radius);
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: .68rem;
  background: var(--surface); color: var(--text);
  padding: 0 6px; cursor: pointer;
}
.sel-in:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent2); }
.field-note {
  font-size: .58rem; color: var(--muted);
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
}

/* ── SEQUENCE ROWS ───────────────────────────────── */
.mirror-lbl {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: .68rem; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer;
}
.mirror-lbl input {
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  accent-color: var(--accent2); cursor: pointer;
}

.ins-btn {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  height: 16px; width: 100%;
  background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
  color: transparent; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1;
  border-radius: 2px; transition: color .1s, background .1s; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ins-btn:hover { color: var(--accent2); background: #eef3fd; }

.seq-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 2px 3px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  transition: background .1s;
  position: relative;
}
.seq-row:hover { background: var(--surface2); }

.cdrop { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }
.cdrop-btn {
  width: 32px; height: 28px; border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-md); cursor: pointer;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color .1s, box-shadow .1s; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.cdrop-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #d0e2f8; }
.cdrop-btn .sw { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.cdrop-btn .caret {
  position: absolute; bottom: 3px; right: 3px;
  width: 0; height: 0;
  border-left: 3px solid transparent;
  border-right: 3px solid transparent;
  border-top: 4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);
  pointer-events: none;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5));
}
.cdrop-menu {
  position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 4px); left: 0; z-index: 600;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-md);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  display: none; flex-wrap: wrap;
  width: 96px;
}
.cdrop-menu.open { display: flex; }
.cdrop-opt {
  width: 24px; height: 24px; cursor: pointer;
  border: none; padding: 0; flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: transform .08s;
}
.cdrop-opt:hover { transform: scale(1.18); z-index: 1; position: relative; }

.seq-x { display: none; }

.seq-n {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0;
  height: 28px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-md); border-radius: 4px;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: .72rem;
  text-align: center; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text);
  transition: border-color .1s, box-shadow .1s;
}
.seq-n:hover { border-color: var(--border-md); }
.seq-n:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #d0e2f8; }

/* ── DRAG & MULTI-SELECT ─────────────────────────── */
.seq-drag-handle {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  width: 13px; height: 28px;
  cursor: grab; flex-shrink: 0;
  color: transparent;
  font-size: 11px; line-height: 1;
  user-select: none;
  transition: color .1s;
}
.seq-row:hover .seq-drag-handle { color: var(--border-md); }
.seq-drag-handle:hover { color: var(--muted) !important; }
.seq-drag-handle:active { cursor: grabbing; }

.seq-sel-dot {
  width: 13px; height: 28px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0; cursor: pointer;
}
.seq-sel-dot::before {
  content: '';
  width: 7px; height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  transition: all .12s;
  display: block;
}
.seq-row:hover .seq-sel-dot::before { border-color: var(--border-md); }
.seq-sel-dot:hover::before { border-color: var(--accent2) !important; background: var(--sel-dot-hover-bg); }
.seq-row.sel-active .seq-sel-dot::before {
  background: var(--accent2);
  border-color: var(--accent2);
}
.seq-row.sel-active {
  background: var(--sel-highlight);
}

.seq-rm {
  background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
  color: transparent;
  padding: 2px 3px; border-radius: 3px;
  font-size: 10px; line-height: 1;
  transition: color .1s, background .1s; flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 20px; height: 20px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.seq-row:hover .seq-rm { color: var(--border-md); }
.seq-rm:hover { color: var(--accent) !important; background: #fdecea; }

.seq-row.seq-dragging { opacity: .3; pointer-events: none; }
.seq-row.seq-drag-over-top    { box-shadow: 0 -2px 0 0 var(--accent2); }
.seq-row.seq-drag-over-bottom { box-shadow:  0 2px 0 0 var(--accent2); }

/* ── THREAD PROGRESS BAR ─────────────────────────── */
.thread-progress-wrap {
  margin-top: 6px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
}
.thread-progress-track {
  width: 100%;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--border);
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}
.thread-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: width .2s ease, background .2s ease;
  position: relative;
}
.thread-progress-track::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(45deg,#ccc 25%,transparent 25%),
    linear-gradient(-45deg,#ccc 25%,transparent 25%),
    linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 75%,#ccc 75%),
    linear-gradient(-45deg,transparent 75%,#ccc 75%);
  background-size: 6px 6px;
  background-position: 0 0, 0 3px, 3px -3px, -3px 0;
  background-color: #e8e4de;
  z-index: 0;
}
.thread-progress-fill { z-index: 1; }
.thread-progress-over {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: .55;
  z-index: 2;
  border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
}
.thread-progress-label {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .58rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.thread-progress-label .pct {
  font-weight: 500;
}
.thread-progress-label .pct.full  { color: var(--green); }
.thread-progress-label .pct.over  { color: var(--accent); }
.thread-progress-label .pct.empty { color: var(--muted); }

/* ── INLINE WARNING CHIP ─────────────────────────── */
.seq-warn {
  display: none;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .6rem;
  color: var(--accent);
  background: #fdecea;
  border: 1px solid #f5c2bb;
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 3px 7px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.seq-warn.visible { display: block; }

.sym-note {
  font-size: .67rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.5;
}
.sym-note a {
  color: var(--accent2); cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: underline; font-weight: 500;
}
.btn-link {
  font-size: .62rem; color: var(--muted); background: none; border: none;
  cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; text-align: left; padding: 0;
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
}
.btn-link:hover { color: var(--green); }

.border-note {
  font-size: .62rem; color: var(--muted);
  background: #fffbf0;
  border: 1px solid #e8d9a0;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 5px 7px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.border-note b { color: var(--text); font-weight: 500; }

/* ── PREVIEW AREA ────────────────────────────────── */
.preview-area {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--bg);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 20px 24px 0 24px;
  gap: 12px;
}

.preview-bar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.preview-bar-left {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px;
}
.preview-lbl {
  font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
  font-size: .95rem; color: var(--text);
}
.preview-meta {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .6rem; color: var(--muted);
}

.thread-readout {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
}
.trd-stat {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .6rem; color: var(--muted);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 3px 7px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
}
.trd-stat b { color: var(--text); font-weight: 500; }
.trd-warn {
  font-size: .58rem; color: #a07020;
  background: #fffbf0; border: 1px solid #e8d9a0;
  border-radius: 2px; padding: 3px 6px;
  display: none;
}
.trd-warn.visible { display: block; }

.canvas-wrap {
  flex: 1;
  position: relative;
  overflow: auto;
  min-height: 0;
  cursor: default;
}

/* Zoom host — provides scroll space matching the scaled frame */
.zoom-host {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 100%;
}

/* Zoom badge */
.zoom-badge {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 14px;
  right: 10px;
  z-index: 20;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  background: rgba(26,23,20,.72);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .58rem;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.8);
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity .25s;
}
.zoom-badge.visible { opacity: 1; }

.canvas-frame {
  position: relative;
  /* Checkerboard = transparency indicator, drawn in CSS under the visCanvas */
  background-color: #e8e4de;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(45deg,#c0c0c0 25%,transparent 25%),
    linear-gradient(-45deg,#c0c0c0 25%,transparent 25%),
    linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 75%,#c0c0c0 75%),
    linear-gradient(-45deg,transparent 75%,#c0c0c0 75%);
  background-size: 12px 12px;
  background-position: 0 0, 0 6px, 6px -6px, -6px 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
}

.resize-handle {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 8px;
  cursor: ns-resize;
  z-index: 10;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    transparent 0%,
    rgba(0,0,0,.06) 100%
  );
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.resize-handle::after {
  content: '';
  width: 32px; height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--border-md);
  opacity: .7;
}
.resize-handle:hover::after { background: var(--accent2); opacity: 1; }

.empty-overlay {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;

  align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;

}
.empty-overlay .ei { font-size: 2rem; opacity: .12; }
.empty-overlay p {

  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); opacity: .4;
}

#tileCanvas { display: none; }

.pattern-diagram {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface);
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.pd-border-l, .pd-border-r {
  height: 100%;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0px, var(--accent) 1px,
    transparent 1px, transparent 3px
  );
  opacity: .4;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  min-width: 2px;
}
.pd-main {
  flex: 1;
  height: 100%;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent2) 0px, var(--accent2) 1px,
    transparent 1px, transparent 4px
  );
  opacity: .25;
}
.pd-lbl {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .52rem; color: var(--muted);
  padding: 0 4px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 4px; height: 4px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border-md); border-radius: 2px; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   NUMBER SCRUBBER  —  Figma / Photoshop style
   Shows ↔ cursor on hover to signal "drag to change"
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
input[type=number]:not(:focus) {
  cursor: ew-resize;
}
/* Subtle dashed bottom border on unfocused num inputs → visual affordance */
.num-in:not(:focus),
.seq-n:not(:focus) {
  border-bottom-style: dashed;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MOBILE TAB BAR + BOTTOM SHEET
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root { --tabbar-h: 56px; }

.mobile-tabbar {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: var(--tabbar-h);
  background: var(--text);
  z-index: 350;
  align-items: stretch;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
.mob-tab {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  gap: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  transition: color .15s, background .15s;
  border: none; background: none;
  padding: 0;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}
.mob-tab.active {
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
}
.mob-tab svg { flex-shrink: 0; }
.mob-tab-lbl {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: .5rem; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1;
}

.mobile-sheet-pill {
  display: none;
  width: 36px; height: 4px;
  background: var(--border-md);
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin: 8px auto 4px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.seq-move-btns { display: none; }
.seq-move-btn  { display: none; }

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .nav-info { display: none; }

  .workspace {
    height: calc(100vh - var(--nav-h) - var(--tabbar-h));
  }

  .preview-area {
    padding: 12px 12px 8px;
  }

  .sidebar {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: var(--tabbar-h);
    left: 0; right: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 40vh;
    border-right: none;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0;
    box-shadow: 0 -6px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
    z-index: 300;
    transform: translateY(calc(100% + 1px));
    transition: transform .28s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1);
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  .sidebar.mobile-open {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  .sidebar.mobile-open .sec {
    display: none;
  }
  .sidebar.mobile-open .sec.mobile-active {
    display: flex;
  }
  .sidebar.mobile-open .sec.mobile-active .sec-hd {
    display: none;
  }
  .sidebar.mobile-open .sec.mobile-active .sec-body {
    max-height: none !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
    padding: 10px 12px !important;
  }
  .sidebar.mobile-open .sec.mobile-active .sec-sticky-bar {
    display: block;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
  }

  .mobile-sheet-pill { display: block; }
  .mobile-tabbar { display: flex; }

  .canvas-frame { border-radius: 6px; }
  .preview-bar { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  .thread-readout { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; }

  .seq-row {
    min-height: 52px;
    padding: 4px 6px;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .cdrop-btn {
    width: 44px; height: 44px;
    border-radius: 6px;
  }
  .cdrop-opt { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
  .cdrop-menu { width: 144px; }

  .seq-n {
    height: 44px;
    font-size: .9rem;
    border-radius: 6px;
  }

  .seq-drag-handle {
    display: flex !important;
    width: 36px; height: 44px;
    color: var(--border-md) !important;
    font-size: 16px;
    background: var(--surface2);
    border-radius: 6px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    touch-action: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .seq-drag-handle:active { background: #eef3fd; color: var(--accent2) !important; }

  .seq-move-btns { display: none !important; }

  .seq-sel-dot {
    width: 36px; height: 44px;
  }
  .seq-sel-dot::before {
    width: 13px; height: 13px;
    border-color: var(--border-md) !important;
  }

  .seq-rm {
    color: var(--border-md) !important;
    width: 36px; height: 36px;
    font-size: 14px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .seq-rm:active { color: var(--accent) !important; background: #fdecea; }

  .ins-btn {
    height: 28px;
    color: var(--border-md) !important;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .mirror-lbl { font-size: .78rem; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 0; }
  .mirror-lbl input { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

  .num-in { height: 40px !important; font-size: .82rem; }
  .sel-in { height: 40px !important; font-size: .82rem; }

  .field { gap: 8px; }
  .field-row { gap: 10px; }

  /* On touch, cursor scrub doesn't apply — reset cursor */
  input[type=number]:not(:focus) { cursor: auto; }
  .num-in:not(:focus), .seq-n:not(:focus) { border-bottom-style: solid; }
}

/* ── GROUPS ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.seq-group {
  margin: 2px 0 1px;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.02);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: visible;
  transition: border-color .12s, background .12s;
}
/* Selected group — highlighted with a visible border + tint */
.seq-group.grp-selected {
  border-color: var(--accent2);
  background: rgba(42,110,196,.06);
}
.seq-group-hd {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  padding: 3px 6px 3px 5px;
  user-select: none; min-height: 30px;
  border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0;
}
.seq-group:not(.collapsed) .seq-group-hd {
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07);
}
.seq-group.grp-selected:not(.collapsed) .seq-group-hd {
  border-bottom-color: rgba(42,110,196,.18);
}
.seq-group.collapsed .seq-group-hd { border-radius: 5px; }
/* Collapse icon — bigger and clearly legible */
.seq-group-collapse {
  width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0;
  background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: transform .12s, background .1s, color .1s;
}
.seq-group-collapse:hover { background: var(--surface2); color: var(--text); }
.seq-group.collapsed .seq-group-collapse { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
.seq-group-name {
  flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: .63rem; font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text); outline: none; cursor: text;
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
  border-radius: 2px; padding: 1px 3px;
  border: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color .1s;
}
.seq-group-name:focus {
  background: var(--surface); border-color: var(--accent2);
  text-overflow: clip; overflow: visible;
}
.seq-group-badge {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: .56rem;
  color: var(--muted); background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 0 4px; flex-shrink: 0; line-height: 1.7;
}
.seq-group-preview {
  height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; flex-shrink: 0;
  display: block; width: 52px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12); transition: width .15s;
}
.seq-group.collapsed .seq-group-preview { width: 80px; }
.seq-group-body { padding: 2px 0 4px 6px; position: relative; }
/* Hidden rows / groups */
.seq-row.row-hidden .cdrop-btn,
.seq-row.row-hidden .seq-n { opacity: .35; }
.seq-row.row-hidden { background: repeating-linear-gradient(
  -45deg, transparent, transparent 4px, rgba(0,0,0,.03) 4px, rgba(0,0,0,.03) 5px); }
.seq-group.grp-hidden { opacity: .45; }
.seq-group.grp-hidden .seq-group-hd { text-decoration: line-through; }
/* Undo/redo toolbar */
.undo-bar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  margin-left: auto;
}
.undo-btn {
  height: 26px; min-width: 32px;
  background: var(--nav-btn-bg); border: 1px solid var(--nav-btn-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--nav-text-dim);
  font-size: .65rem; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  cursor: pointer; padding: 0 8px;
  transition: background .1s, color .1s;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
}
.undo-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--nav-btn-hover-bg); color: var(--nav-text); }
.undo-btn:disabled { opacity: .3; cursor: default; }

.theme-toggle-btn {
  height: 26px; width: 26px;
  background: var(--nav-btn-bg); border: 1px solid var(--nav-btn-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius); color: var(--nav-text-bright);
  font-size: .8rem; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
  transition: background .1s, color .1s;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin-left: 8px;
}
.theme-toggle-btn:hover { background: var(--nav-btn-hover-bg); color: var(--nav-text); }

/* Project name in nav */
.nav-project-name {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .68rem;
  color: var(--nav-text-bright);
  padding: 0 14px;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--nav-border);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--nav-border);
  height: 100%;
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 200px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.nav-project-name .proj-label {
  font-size: .53rem;
  color: var(--nav-text-dim);
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.nav-project-name .proj-title {
  white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
  color: var(--nav-text);
}

/* Settings text input */
.txt-in {
  width: 100%; height: 26px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-md); border-radius: var(--radius);
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: .7rem;
  padding: 0 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text);
  transition: border-color .1s;
}
.txt-in:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent2); }

/* Hannah bordered box */
.hannah-box {
  border: 1px solid var(--border-md);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 8px 10px;
  background: var(--surface2);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px;
}
.hannah-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
}
.hannah-row .field-lbl { margin-bottom: 0; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* Border mirror sections */
.border-mirror-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.border-side-label {
  font-size: .58rem; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted); padding: 3px 0 1px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

/* ── CONTEXT MENU ──────────────────────────────────── */
.ctx-menu {
  position: fixed; background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-md);
  border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); z-index: 9999;
  display: none; min-width: 155px; padding: 3px 0;
}
.ctx-menu.open { display: block; }
.ctx-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  width: 100%; padding: 6px 12px;
  background: none; border: none; text-align: left;
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: .72rem;
  color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background .07s;
}
.ctx-item:hover { background: var(--surface2); }
.ctx-item .ctx-kbd {
  margin-left: auto; padding-left: 14px;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: .57rem; color: var(--muted);
}
.ctx-item.danger { color: var(--accent); }
.ctx-sep { height: 1px; background: var(--border); margin: 3px 0; }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

const M = {

  y_list:[], y_rowIds:[], y_groups:[], y_hidden:new Set(),

// ── ID counters ──────────────────────────────────────────────
let _rowIdCtr = 0, _grpIdCtr = 0;
function newRowId() { return ++_rowIdCtr; }
function newGrpId() { return ++_grpIdCtr; }

// ── Dim accessors ────────────────────────────────────────────
function getList(d)    { return d==='x'?M.x_list   :d==='y'?M.y_list   :d==='br'?M.br_list  :M.b_list;    }
function getRowIds(d)  { return d==='x'?M.x_rowIds :d==='y'?M.y_rowIds :d==='br'?M.br_rowIds:M.b_rowIds;  }
function getGroups(d)  { return d==='x'?M.x_groups :d==='y'?M.y_groups :d==='br'?M.br_groups:M.b_groups;  }

function setGroups(d,v){ if(d==='x')M.x_groups=v; else if(d==='y')M.y_groups=v; else if(d==='br')M.br_groups=v; else M.b_groups=v; }
function setHidden(d,v){ if(d==='x')M.x_hidden=v; else if(d==='y')M.y_hidden=v; else if(d==='br')M.br_hidden=v; else M.b_hidden=v; }

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPAND
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function expand(list, mirror, dim) {
  const hidden = dim ? getHidden(dim) : null;
  const ids    = dim ? getRowIds(dim) : null;
  const base = [];
  for (let ri = 0; ri < list.length; ri++) {
    if (hidden && ids && hidden.has(ids[ri])) continue;
    const [ci, cnt] = list[ri];
    const hex = M.color(ci);
    for (let i = 0; i < cnt; i++) base.push(hex);
  }
  if (!base.length) return [];
  if (!mirror) return base;
  const rev = [...base].reverse();
  return [...rev, ...base];
}

// REPLACE the entire expandBorder() function
function expandBorder() {
  const lim = getThreadLimits();
  const borderSide = lim.borderSide;
  if (borderSide === 0) return { left: [], right: [] };

  function buildPattern(list, hidden, ids) {
    const pattern = [];
    for (let ri = 0; ri < list.length; ri++) {
      if (hidden.has(ids[ri])) continue;
      const [ci, cnt] = list[ri];
      const hex = M.color(ci);
      for (let i = 0; i < cnt; i++) pattern.push(hex);
    }
    return pattern;
  }

  const trimToSide = (pattern) => {
    const arr = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < borderSide; i++) {
      arr.push(i < pattern.length ? pattern[i] : null);
    }
    return arr;
  };

  const leftPattern = buildPattern(M.b_list, M.b_hidden, M.b_rowIds);
  const isMirrored  = document.getElementById('borderMirror')?.checked !== false;

  let rightPattern;
  if (isMirrored) {
    // Mirror: reverse left so outer edge reflects outer edge
    rightPattern = [...leftPattern].reverse();
  } else {
    // Independent: br_list row 0 = leftmost (inner) thread of right border
    rightPattern = M.br_list.length > 0
      ? buildPattern(M.br_list, M.br_hidden, M.br_rowIds)
      : [...leftPattern].reverse();   // graceful fallback
  }

  return { left: trimToSide(leftPattern), right: trimToSide(rightPattern) };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TWILL
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function twillBit(row, col, t) {
  switch (t) {
    case '1x1':   return (row + col) % 2;
    case '2x2':   return Math.floor(((row + col) % 4) / 2);
    case 'weft':  return 1;
    case 'warp':  return 0;
    case 'border': return 0;
    default:      return (row + col) % 2;
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// HEX → RGB
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function h2r(h) {
  h = h.replace('#', '');
  return [parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16), parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16), parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16)];
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// RAF-THROTTLED REDRAW
// All callers use scheduleRedraw() so multiple rapid changes
// (scrubber drag, resize observer, etc.) collapse into one
// paint per animation frame — eliminates lag entirely.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
let _rafPending = false;
function scheduleRedraw() {
  if (_rafPending) return;
  _rafPending = true;
  scheduleSave();
  requestAnimationFrame(() => { _rafPending = false; redraw(); });
}












function _renderFastTile(ctx, W, H, warp, weft, twill, startThread, endThread, fracX, pxPerThread) {
  const tileW      = endThread - startThread;
  if (tileW <= 0) return;
  const borderOnly   = twill === 'border';
  const warpOnlyMode = twill === 'warp';
  const weftOnlyMode = twill === 'weft';
  const weftEmpty    = weft.length === 0 || warpOnlyMode;
  const tileH        = weftEmpty ? 1 : Math.max(1, weft.length);

  const tc  = document.getElementById('tileCanvas');
  tc.width  = tileW;
  tc.height = tileH;
  const tctx = tc.getContext('2d');
  const img  = tctx.createImageData(tileW, tileH);
  const px32 = new Uint32Array(img.data.buffer);

  function mkpx(r,g,b) { return (0xFF000000|(b<<16)|(g<<8)|r)>>>0; }
  const TRANS = 0x00000000;

  const warpCache = new Uint32Array(tileW);
  const warpNull  = new Uint8Array(tileW);
  for (let ci = 0; ci < tileW; ci++) {
    const h = warp[startThread + ci];
    if (h == null) { warpNull[ci] = 1; continue; }
    const [r,g,b] = h2r(h); warpCache[ci] = mkpx(r,g,b);
  }

  for (let row = 0; row < tileH; row++) {
    const weftHex = (!weftEmpty && weft.length) ? weft[row % weft.length] : null;
    let er=0, eg=0, eb=0, weftPx=TRANS;
    if (weftHex) { [er,eg,eb] = h2r(weftHex); weftPx = mkpx(er,eg,eb); }

    for (let ci = 0; ci < tileW; ci++) {
      const pi  = row * tileW + ci;
      const col = startThread + ci;

      if (weftOnlyMode) { px32[pi] = weftHex ? weftPx : TRANS; continue; }
      if (warpNull[ci]) {
        px32[pi] = (!borderOnly && !warpOnlyMode && weftHex) ? weftPx : TRANS;
        continue;
      }
      const wc = warpCache[ci];
      if (weftEmpty || !weftHex) { px32[pi] = wc; continue; }
      px32[pi] = twillBit(row, col, twill) === 1 ? weftPx : wc;
    }
  }
  tctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);

  // How many tile columns map to the canvas width at this zoom
  const srcW  = Math.min(tileW - fracX, W / pxPerThread);
  const destH = Math.max(1, Math.round(tileH * (W / srcW)));

  // Smooth only when many threads compress into < 1.2px — otherwise crisp
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = pxPerThread < 1.2;
  if (ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled) ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'medium';

  ctx.drawImage(tc, fracX, 0, srcW, tileH, 0, 0, W, destH);

  // Tile vertically
  for (let y = destH; y < H; y += destH) {
    const rH = Math.min(destH, H - y);
    ctx.drawImage(ctx.canvas, 0, 0, W, rH, 0, y, W, rH);
  }
}








// Returns a canvas gradient giving a cylindrical highlight.
// dir 'v' → horizontal gradient (warp thread);  'h' → vertical (weft thread).
function _cylinderGrad(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, g, b, dir) {
  const size = dir === 'v' ? w : h;
  if (size < 2) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`; return null; }
  const hi = c => Math.min(255, c + 62);
  const lo = c => Math.max(0,   c - 52);
  const grd = dir === 'v'
    ? ctx.createLinearGradient(x,     0, x + w, 0)
    : ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y,     0, y + h);
  grd.addColorStop(0,    `rgb(${lo(r)},${lo(g)},${lo(b)})`);
  grd.addColorStop(0.22, `rgb(${hi(r)},${hi(g)},${hi(b)})`);
  grd.addColorStop(0.58, `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`);
  grd.addColorStop(1,    `rgb(${lo(r)},${lo(g)},${lo(b)})`);
  return grd;
}

function _renderHighDetail(ctx, W, H, warp, weft, twill, startThread, endThread, fracX, pxPerThread) {
  const borderOnly   = twill === 'border';
  const warpOnlyMode = twill === 'warp';
  const weftOnlyMode = twill === 'weft';
  const weftEmpty    = weft.length === 0 || warpOnlyMode;
  const nWeft        = weft.length || 1;
  const pxR          = pxPerThread;                    // weft row height = thread width (square)
  const rowsInView   = Math.ceil(H / pxR) + 1;
  const DIM          = 0.42;                            // shadow factor for under-thread
  const hi           = c => Math.min(255, c + 62);
  const lo           = c => Math.max(0,   c - 52);

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // ── Warp-only / empty-weft fast path ──────────────────────
  if (weftEmpty) {
    let x = -fracX * pxPerThread;
    for (let ci = startThread; x < W; ci++, x += pxPerThread) {
      if (ci >= warp.length) break;
      const h = warp[ci]; if (h == null) continue;
      const [r,g,b] = h2r(h);
      const grd = _cylinderGrad(ctx, x, 0, pxPerThread, H, r, g, b, 'v');
      ctx.fillStyle = grd || `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
      ctx.fillRect(x, 0, pxPerThread, H);
    }
    return;
  }

  // ── Weft-only fast path ────────────────────────────────────
  if (weftOnlyMode) {
    const startRow = Math.floor(viewPanY);
    const fracY = viewPanY - startRow;
    const fracOffset = fracY * pxR;
    for (let ri = startRow; ri < nWeft && (ri - startRow) * pxR < H + fracOffset; ri++) {
      const y = (ri - startRow) * pxR - fracOffset; if (y >= H) break;
      const h = weft[ri % nWeft]; const [r,g,b] = h2r(h);
      const grd = _cylinderGrad(ctx, 0, y, W, pxR, r, g, b, 'h');
      ctx.fillStyle = grd || `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
      ctx.fillRect(0, y, W, pxR);
    }
    return;
  }

  // ── Pass 1: solid weft bands (background fill) ────────────
  let prevHex = null;
  const startRow = Math.floor(viewPanY);
  const fracY = viewPanY - startRow;
  const fracOffset = fracY * pxR;
  for (let ri = startRow; ri < nWeft && (ri - startRow) * pxR < H + fracOffset; ri++) {
    const y = (ri - startRow) * pxR - fracOffset; if (y >= H) break;
    const h = weft[ri % nWeft];
    if (h !== prevHex) { ctx.fillStyle = h; prevHex = h; }
    ctx.fillRect(0, y, W, pxR);
  }

  // ── Pass 2: warp columns ──────────────────────────────────
  // For each column: dim the whole column (under-weft background),
  // then paint the warp-on-top rows with cylindrical shading.
  let x = -fracX * pxPerThread;
  for (let ci = startThread; x < W; ci++, x += pxPerThread) {
    if (ci >= warp.length) break;
    const warpHex = warp[ci];
    if (warpHex == null) continue;
    const [wr,wg,wb] = h2r(warpHex);

    // Step A: dim entire column (seen as warp peeking under weft)
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${(wr*DIM)|0},${(wg*DIM)|0},${(wb*DIM)|0})`;
    ctx.fillRect(x, 0, pxPerThread, H);

    // Step B: paint warp-on-top rows with cylindrical gradient
    const grd = _cylinderGrad(ctx, x, 0, pxPerThread, H, wr, wg, wb, 'v');
    if (grd) ctx.fillStyle = grd;
    else     ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${wr},${wg},${wb})`;

    for (let ri = startRow; ri < nWeft && (ri - startRow) * pxR < H + fracOffset; ri++) {
      const y = (ri - startRow) * pxR - fracOffset; if (y >= H) break;
      if (twillBit(ri, ci, twill) === 1) continue;  // weft on top → skip
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, pxPerThread, pxR);
    }

    // Thread-edge shadow lines (visible when threads are wide enough)
    if (pxPerThread >= 5) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
      ctx.fillRect(x,                     0, 0.75, H);
      ctx.fillRect(x + pxPerThread - 0.75, 0, 0.75, H);
    }
  }

  // ── Pass 3: weft threads on top (cylindrical re-paint) ────
  for (let ri = startRow; ri < nWeft && (ri - startRow) * pxR < H + fracOffset; ri++) {
    const y = (ri - startRow) * pxR - fracOffset; if (y >= H) break;
    const weftHex = weft[ri % nWeft];
    const [er,eg,eb] = h2r(weftHex);

    // One gradient per weft row (spans full row height, reused for all runs)
    const grd = _cylinderGrad(ctx, 0, y, W, pxR, er, eg, eb, 'h');

    // Walk the visible columns and collect contiguous weft-on-top runs
    let runStart = null;
    let cx = -fracX * pxPerThread;
    const flushRun = (endX) => {
      if (runStart == null) return;
      ctx.fillStyle = grd || `rgb(${er},${eg},${eb})`;
      ctx.fillRect(runStart, y, endX - runStart, pxR);
      runStart = null;
    };
    for (let ci = startThread; cx < W; ci++, cx += pxPerThread) {
      if (ci >= warp.length) { flushRun(cx); break; }
      const onTop = warp[ci] != null && twillBit(ri, ci, twill) === 1;
      if (onTop) { if (runStart == null) runStart = cx; }
      else         flushRun(cx);
    }
    flushRun(W);

    // Row-edge shadow lines
    if (pxR >= 5) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, y,              W, 0.75);
      ctx.fillRect(0, y + pxR - 0.75, W, 0.75);
    }
  }
}















function redraw() {
  // Check for limit violations first
  const validationOk = displayValidationErrors();
  if (!validationOk) {
    // Don't render if limits are exceeded
    const overlay = document.getElementById('emptyOverlay');
    if (overlay) overlay.style.display = 'flex';
    const vc0 = document.getElementById('visCanvas');
    if (vc0) {
      const area = document.getElementById('previewArea');
      const dispW = area ? Math.max(1, area.clientWidth - 48) : 1;
      const canvasH = Math.max(40, parseInt(document.getElementById('canvasH').value) || 320);
      vc0.width = dispW; vc0.height = canvasH;
      vc0.getContext('2d').clearRect(0, 0, dispW, canvasH);
    }
    return;
  }

  const twill   = document.getElementById('twillSel').value;
  const xMirror = document.getElementById('xMirror').checked;
  const yMirror = false;
  M.twill    = twill;
  M.x_mirror = xMirror;
  M.y_mirror = yMirror;

  const frame   = document.getElementById('canvasFrame');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('emptyOverlay');

  const area    = document.getElementById('previewArea');
  const dispW   = area.clientWidth - 48;

  const totalWarpThreads = Math.max(100, parseInt(document.getElementById('totalWarpIn').value) || 5700);
  const totalWarpNote = document.getElementById('totalWarpNote');
  if (totalWarpNote) totalWarpNote.textContent = totalWarpThreads.toLocaleString() + ' threads';

  const canvasH = Math.max(getMinCanvasHeight(), parseInt(document.getElementById('canvasH').value) || 320);

  const xBase = expand(M.x_list, xMirror, 'x');
  const yBase = expand(M.active_y(), yMirror, 'y');
  const bBoth  = expandBorder();
  const bArr   = bBoth.left;  // left border (used for progress/stats)
  const bArrR  = bBoth.right; // right border

  const has      = xBase.length > 0 && yBase.length > 0;
  const warpOnly = xBase.length > 0 && yBase.length === 0;

  let showContent;
  if (twill === 'warp') {
    showContent = xBase.length > 0 || bArr.length > 0;
  } else if (twill === 'weft') {
    showContent = yBase.length > 0;
  } else if (twill === 'border') {
    showContent = bArr.length > 0;
  } else {
    showContent = has || warpOnly;
  }
  overlay.style.display = showContent ? 'none' : 'flex';

  const lim        = getThreadLimits();
  const borderSide = lim.borderSide;
  let fullWarp = new Array(totalWarpThreads).fill(null);

  const bLeft  = bArr.slice();
  for (let i = 0; i < bLeft.length && i < totalWarpThreads; i++) {
    fullWarp[i] = bLeft[i];
  }

  const bRight = bArrR.slice();
  for (let i = 0; i < bRight.length; i++) {
    const pos = totalWarpThreads - bRight.length + i;
    if (pos >= 0) fullWarp[pos] = bRight[i];
  }

  if ((has || warpOnly) && xBase.length > 0) {
    const designStart = borderSide;
    const designEnd   = totalWarpThreads - borderSide;
    const designSpace = designEnd - designStart;
    const designOffset = Math.max(0, Math.floor((designSpace - xBase.length) / 2));
    let pos = designStart + designOffset;
    for (let i = 0; i < xBase.length && pos < designEnd; i++, pos++) {
      fullWarp[pos] = xBase[i];
    }
  }

  const fullWeft = yBase;

  if (!has && !warpOnly) {
    // No pattern — just show the checkerboard (CSS on frame) with a blank canvas
    const vc0 = document.getElementById('visCanvas');
    vc0.width = dispW; vc0.height = canvasH;
    vc0.getContext('2d').clearRect(0, 0, dispW, canvasH);
    frame.style.width  = dispW + 'px';
    frame.style.height = canvasH + 'px';
    updateNavStats(0, 0, 0);
    updateDiagram(0, 0, 0);
    return;
  }

  const weftEmpty    = fullWeft.length === 0;
  const borderOnly   = twill === 'border';
  const warpOnlyMode = twill === 'warp';
  const weftOnlyMode = twill === 'weft';

  // ── viewport setup ────────────────────────────────────────
  const W = dispW, H = canvasH;
  const vc = document.getElementById('visCanvas');
  vc.width  = W; vc.height = H;
  frame.style.width     = W + 'px';
  frame.style.height    = H + 'px';
  frame.style.transform = 'none';   // clear any stale CSS transform

  const nW         = totalWarpThreads;
  const pxPerThread = (W / nW) * viewZoom;  // pixels per thread at current zoom
  const visThreads  = W / pxPerThread;      // number of visible threads
  
  // Clamp viewPanX to valid range to prevent over-panning
  viewPanX = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, nW - visThreads), viewPanX));
  
  // Clamp viewPanY to valid range (vertical pan)
  const pxR = pxPerThread;  // pixel height per weft row
  const visRows = H / pxR;
  const nH = fullWeft.length || 1;
  viewPanY = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, nH - visRows), viewPanY));

  const startThread = Math.floor(viewPanX);
  const fracX       = viewPanX - startThread;  // fractional offset within first visible thread
  const endThread   = Math.min(nW, startThread + Math.ceil(visThreads) + 1);
  const vctx        = vc.getContext('2d');

  // ── LOD dispatch with blend zone ──────────────────────────
  if (pxPerThread >= LOD_TRANS_HI) {
    _renderHighDetail(vctx, W, H, fullWarp, fullWeft, twill,
                      startThread, endThread, fracX, pxPerThread);
  } else if (pxPerThread < LOD_TRANS_LO) {
    _renderFastTile(vctx, W, H, fullWarp, fullWeft, twill,
                    startThread, endThread, fracX, pxPerThread);
  } else {
    // Blend zone: cross-fade from fast → detail to avoid popping
    _renderFastTile(vctx, W, H, fullWarp, fullWeft, twill,
                    startThread, endThread, fracX, pxPerThread);
    const blendAlpha = (pxPerThread - LOD_TRANS_LO) / (LOD_TRANS_HI - LOD_TRANS_LO);
    const tmp = document.createElement('canvas');
    tmp.width = W; tmp.height = H;
    _renderHighDetail(tmp.getContext('2d'), W, H, fullWarp, fullWeft, twill,
                      startThread, endThread, fracX, pxPerThread);
    vctx.globalAlpha = blendAlpha;
    vctx.drawImage(tmp, 0, 0);
    vctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // ── stats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const patternUsed = xBase.length + bArr.length * 2;
  const bCount      = bArr.length;
  updateNavStats(totalWarpThreads, warpOnly ? 0 : fullWeft.length, bCount);
  updateDiagram(bCount, xBase.length, bCount);

  const warn = document.getElementById('densityWarn');
  warn.classList.toggle('visible', pxPerThread < 1);
  document.getElementById('statW').textContent = W + 'px';
  document.getElementById('statTile').textContent =
    `${endThread - startThread}×${fullWeft.length || 1}`;
  document.getElementById('previewMeta').textContent =
    `${nW.toLocaleString()} warp · ${(endThread - startThread).toLocaleString()} visible` +
    ` · ${pxPerThread.toFixed(2)}px/thread · ×${viewZoom.toFixed(1)}`;


}

function getMinCanvasHeight() {
  const yMirror = false;
  const yBase = expand(M.active_y(), yMirror, 'y');
  const weftRepeatLength = yBase.length || 1;
  
  // Get display width and total warp threads
  const area = document.getElementById('previewArea');
  const dispW = area ? Math.max(1, area.clientWidth - 48) : 1;
  const totalWarpThreads = Math.max(100, parseInt(document.getElementById('totalWarpIn').value) || 5700);
  
  // Calculate pixels per thread at BASE zoom (1.0) — independent of current zoom
  const basePxPerThread = dispW / totalWarpThreads;
  
  // Minimum height = one complete weft repeat at base pixel density (not affected by zoom)
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(weftRepeatLength * basePxPerThread));
}

const dragState = { active: false, dim: null, fromIdx: -1, overIdx: -1 };

function dragMove(clientY) {
  if (!dragState.active) return;
  const cid = dragState.dim === 'x' ? 'xRows' : dragState.dim === 'y' ? 'yRows' : dragState.dim === 'br' ? 'bRowsRight' : 'bRows';
  const container = document.getElementById(cid);
  if (!container) return;
  const rows = [...container.querySelectorAll('.seq-row')];
  rows.forEach(r => r.classList.remove('seq-drag-over-top', 'seq-drag-over-bottom'));
  let closest = null, closestDist = Infinity;
  for (const r of rows) {
    const rect = r.getBoundingClientRect();
    const mid  = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
    const dist = Math.abs(clientY - mid);
    if (dist < closestDist) { closestDist = dist; closest = r; }
  }
  if (closest) {
    const rect  = closest.getBoundingClientRect();
    const isTop = clientY < rect.top + rect.height / 2;
    closest.classList.add(isTop ? 'seq-drag-over-top' : 'seq-drag-over-bottom');
    dragState.overIdx = parseInt(closest.dataset.idx) + (isTop ? 0 : 1);
  }
}

function dragEnd() {
  if (!dragState.active) return;
  dragState.active = false;
  const { dim, fromIdx } = dragState;
  const list = getList(dim);
  const cid  = dim === 'x' ? 'xRows' : dim === 'y' ? 'yRows' : dim === 'br' ? 'bRowsRight' : 'bRows';
  const container = document.getElementById(cid);
  if (container) {
    container.querySelectorAll('.seq-row').forEach(r =>
      r.classList.remove('seq-dragging','seq-drag-over-top','seq-drag-over-bottom'));
  }
  const toIdx = dragState.overIdx;
  if (toIdx >= 0 && toIdx !== fromIdx && toIdx !== fromIdx + 1) {
    pushUndo();
    const rowIds = getRowIds(dim);
    const [item]   = list.splice(fromIdx, 1);
    const [itemId] = rowIds.splice(fromIdx, 1);
    const insertAt = toIdx > fromIdx ? toIdx - 1 : toIdx;
    list.splice(insertAt, 0, item);
    rowIds.splice(insertAt, 0, itemId);
    SEL[dim].clear();
    renderSeq(dim);
    updateTotal(dim); scheduleRedraw();
  }
  dragState.overIdx = -1;
}

// SEQUENCE RENDERER  (groups, copy/paste, right-click)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function renderSeq(dim) {
  const list   = getList(dim);
  const rowIds = getRowIds(dim);
  const groups = getGroups(dim);
  const bMirrored = document.getElementById('borderMirror')?.checked !== false;
  const container = document.getElementById(
    dim==='x' ? 'xRows' :
    dim==='y' ? 'yRows' :
    dim==='br' ? 'bRowsRight' :
    bMirrored  ? 'bRows' : 'bRowsLeft'
  );
  if (!container) return;

  for (const idx of [...SEL[dim]]) { if (idx >= list.length) SEL[dim].delete(idx); }

  // Map rowIdx → group
  const inGroup = new Map();
  for (const g of groups) {
    for (const rid of g.rowIds) {
      const idx = rowIds.indexOf(rid);
      if (idx >= 0) inGroup.set(idx, g);
    }
  }

  // Build segments: {type:'group',g,indices} | {type:'row',idx}
  const segs = [];
  let si = 0;
  while (si < list.length) {
    const g = inGroup.get(si);
    if (g) {
      const indices = g.rowIds.map(rid => rowIds.indexOf(rid)).filter(x => x >= 0).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
      segs.push({ type:'group', g, indices });
      si = indices[indices.length-1] + 1;
    } else {
      segs.push({ type:'row', idx:si });
      si++;
    }
  }

  container.innerHTML = '';
  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
  let insPos = 0;

  for (const seg of segs) {
    frag.appendChild(makeInsBtn(dim, insPos, null));
    if (seg.type === 'group') {
      frag.appendChild(makeGroupEl(dim, seg.g, seg.indices));
      insPos = seg.indices[seg.indices.length-1] + 1;
    } else {
      frag.appendChild(makeRowEl(dim, seg.idx));
      insPos = seg.idx + 1;
    }
  }

function drawGroupPreview(canvas, indices, list) {
  const total = indices.reduce((s,idx) => s + list[idx][1], 0);
  if (!total) return;
  const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  let x = 0;
  for (const idx of indices) {
    const [ci, cnt] = list[idx];
    ctx.fillStyle = M.color(ci);
    const sw = (cnt/total)*w;
    ctx.fillRect(x, 0, sw, h);
    x += sw;
  }
}

function showRowCtxMenu(e, dim, grp, rowIdx) {
  const sel = [...SEL[dim]].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  if (!sel.length) return;

  const isContig = sel.length===1 || sel.every((v,i,a) => i===0||v===a[i-1]+1);
  const noGrpOverlap = (() => {
    const ids=getRowIds(dim), grps=getGroups(dim);
    const inG=new Set();
    for(const g of grps) for(const rid of g.rowIds){ const idx=ids.indexOf(rid); if(idx>=0) inG.add(idx); }
    return !sel.some(i => inG.has(i));
  })();
  const canGroup = isContig && noGrpOverlap;

  // Hide / show state of selected rows
  const ids = getRowIds(dim), hidden = getHidden(dim);
  const anyVisible = sel.some(i => !hidden.has(ids[i]));
  const anyHidden  = sel.some(i =>  hidden.has(ids[i]));

  const items = [
    { label:'Copy', kbd:'Ctrl+C', action:()=>copySelection(dim) },
    { label:'Cut',  kbd:'Ctrl+X', action:()=>{ pushUndo(); cutSelection(dim); } },
  ];
  if (canGroup) {
    items.push({ sep:true });
    items.push({ label:'Group', kbd:'Ctrl+G', action:()=>{ pushUndo(); groupSelection(dim); } });
  }
  if (grp) {
    items.push({ sep:true });
    items.push({ label:'Ungroup', action:()=>{
      pushUndo();
      const gs=getGroups(dim); const i=gs.findIndex(g=>g.id===grp.id);
      if(i>=0) gs.splice(i,1); renderSeq(dim);
    }});
  }
  items.push({ sep:true });
  if (anyVisible) items.push({ label:'Hide',    action:()=>{ pushUndo(); setRowsHidden(dim, sel, true);  } });
  if (anyHidden)  items.push({ label:'Show',    action:()=>{ pushUndo(); setRowsHidden(dim, sel, false); } });
  items.push({ sep:true });
  items.push({ label:'Delete', kbd:'Del', danger:true, action:()=>{ pushUndo(); deleteSelection(dim); } });

  openCtxMenu(e, items);
}

// ── Clipboard operations ──────────────────────────────────────
function isContiguousSel(dim) {
  const sel=[...SEL[dim]].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  if(!sel.length) return false;
  return sel.every((v,i,a) => i===0||v===a[i-1]+1);
}

function copySelection(dim) {
  const sel=[...SEL[dim]].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  if(!sel.length) return;
  const list=getList(dim), ids=getRowIds(dim), grps=getGroups(dim);
  const rows = sel.map(i=>[...list[i]]);
  const selIds = sel.map(i=>ids[i]);
  const cbGrps = [];
  for(const g of grps){
    const gi=g.rowIds.map(rid=>ids.indexOf(rid)).filter(x=>x>=0);
    if(gi.length&&gi.every(idx=>SEL[dim].has(idx))){
      cbGrps.push({ name:g.name, offsets:gi.map(idx=>sel.indexOf(idx)) });
    }
  }
  CB = { dim, rows, groups:cbGrps };
}

function cutSelection(dim) { copySelection(dim); deleteSelection(dim); }

function deleteSelection(dim) {
  const sel=[...SEL[dim]].sort((a,b)=>b-a);
  if(!sel.length) return;
  const list=getList(dim), ids=getRowIds(dim), grps=getGroups(dim);
  const removedIds=sel.map(i=>ids[i]);
  for(const i of sel){ list.splice(i,1); ids.splice(i,1); }
  for(const g of grps) g.rowIds=g.rowIds.filter(rid=>!removedIds.includes(rid));
  setGroups(dim, grps.filter(g=>g.rowIds.length>0));
  SEL[dim].clear();
  renderSeq(dim); updateTotal(dim); scheduleRedraw();
}

function groupSelection(dim) {
  const sel=[...SEL[dim]].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  if(!sel.length||!isContiguousSel(dim)) return;
  const ids=getRowIds(dim), grps=getGroups(dim);
  // Ensure none in existing group
  const inG=new Set();
  for(const g of grps) for(const rid of g.rowIds){ const idx=ids.indexOf(rid); if(idx>=0) inG.add(idx); }
  if(sel.some(i=>inG.has(i))) return;
  const grpRowIds=sel.map(i=>ids[i]);
  grps.push({ id:newGrpId(), name:'Group', rowIds:grpRowIds, collapsed:false });
  SEL[dim].clear();
  renderSeq(dim); updateTotal(dim); scheduleRedraw();
}

function pasteAt(dim, insertIdx) {
  if(!CB||CB.dim!==dim) return;
  const list=getList(dim), ids=getRowIds(dim), grps=getGroups(dim);
  const newRows=CB.rows.map(r=>[...r]);
  const newIds=newRows.map(()=>newRowId());
  list.splice(insertIdx,0,...newRows);
  ids.splice(insertIdx,0,...newIds);
  for(const cg of CB.groups){
    const gIds=cg.offsets.map(off=>newIds[off]);
    grps.push({ id:newGrpId(), name:cg.name+' copy', rowIds:gIds, collapsed:false });
  }
  SEL[dim].clear();
  for(let i=insertIdx;i<insertIdx+newRows.length;i++) SEL[dim].add(i);
  renderSeq(dim); updateTotal(dim); scheduleRedraw();
}


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// UNDO / REDO  (unlimited steps, up to 100 stored)
// We snapshot the mutable parts of M + SEL + SEL_GROUPS + CB.
// Call pushUndo() before any destructive action.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const UNDO_STACK = [];  // array of snapshots (oldest first)
const REDO_STACK = [];
const UNDO_LIMIT = 100;

function snapshotDim(d) {
  return {
    list:   getList(d).map(r=>[...r]),
    rowIds: [...getRowIds(d)],
    groups: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(getGroups(d))),
    hidden: new Set(getHidden(d)),
  };
}
function restoreDim(d, snap) {
  const list = getList(d), ids = getRowIds(d);
  list.length = 0; list.push(...snap.list.map(r=>[...r]));
  ids.length  = 0; ids.push(...snap.rowIds);
  setGroups(d, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snap.groups)));
  setHidden(d, new Set(snap.hidden));
}

function takeSnapshot() {
  return {
    x: snapshotDim('x'), y: snapshotDim('y'), b: snapshotDim('b'), br: snapshotDim('br'),
    selX:[...SEL.x], selY:[...SEL.y], selB:[...SEL.b], selBr:[...SEL.br],
    sgX:[...SEL_GROUPS.x], sgY:[...SEL_GROUPS.y], sgB:[...SEL_GROUPS.b], sgBr:[...SEL_GROUPS.br],
    cb: CB ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(CB)) : null,
    colors: [...M.colors],
  };
}

function pushUndo() {
  UNDO_STACK.push(takeSnapshot());
  if (UNDO_STACK.length > UNDO_LIMIT) UNDO_STACK.shift();
  REDO_STACK.length = 0;
  updateUndoUI();
}

function applySnapshot(snap) {
  restoreDim('x', snap.x); restoreDim('y', snap.y); restoreDim('b', snap.b); restoreDim('br', snap.br);
  SEL.x = new Set(snap.selX); SEL.y = new Set(snap.selY); SEL.b = new Set(snap.selB);
  SEL.br = snap.selBr ? new Set(snap.selBr) : new Set();
  SEL_GROUPS.x = new Set(snap.sgX); SEL_GROUPS.y = new Set(snap.sgY); SEL_GROUPS.b = new Set(snap.sgB);
  SEL_GROUPS.br = snap.sgBr ? new Set(snap.sgBr) : new Set();
  CB = snap.cb ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snap.cb)) : null;
  if (snap.colors) { M.colors.length = 0; M.colors.push(...snap.colors); renderPalette(); }
  renderSeq('x'); renderSeq('y'); renderSeq('b');
  if (!document.getElementById('borderMirror').checked) renderSeq('br');
  updateTotal('b'); updateTotal('x'); scheduleRedraw();
}

function doUndo() {
  if (!UNDO_STACK.length) return;
  REDO_STACK.push(takeSnapshot());
  applySnapshot(UNDO_STACK.pop());
  updateUndoUI();
}

function doRedo() {
  if (!REDO_STACK.length) return;
  UNDO_STACK.push(takeSnapshot());
  applySnapshot(REDO_STACK.pop());
  updateUndoUI();
}

function updateUndoUI() {
  const u = document.getElementById('undoBtn');
  const r = document.getElementById('redoBtn');
  if (u) u.disabled = UNDO_STACK.length === 0;
  if (r) r.disabled = REDO_STACK.length === 0;
}

document.getElementById('undoBtn').addEventListener('click', doUndo);
document.getElementById('redoBtn').addEventListener('click', doRedo);

// ── Last-clicked row index per dim (for Shift-range selection) ──
const lastClicked = { x:-1, y:-1, b:-1 };

// ── Keyboard shortcuts ────────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.target && (e.target.isContentEditable || ['INPUT','TEXTAREA','SELECT'].includes(e.target.tagName))) return;
  const dim = activeDim;
  if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
    switch (e.key) {
      case '=': case '+': e.preventDefault(); setZoom(viewZoom * (1 + ZOOM_STEP), null); return;
      case '-':           e.preventDefault(); setZoom(viewZoom * (1 - ZOOM_STEP), null); return;
      case '0':           e.preventDefault(); resetZoom(); return;
    }
    switch (e.key.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'z': e.preventDefault(); doUndo(); return;
      case 'y': e.preventDefault(); doRedo(); return;
      case 'c':
        if(SEL[dim].size||SEL_GROUPS[dim].size){ e.preventDefault(); copySelection(dim); } break;
      case 'x':
        if(SEL[dim].size||SEL_GROUPS[dim].size){ e.preventDefault(); cutSelection(dim); } break;
      case 'v':
        if(CB&&CB.dim===dim){
          e.preventDefault();
          const lst=getList(dim), sel=[...SEL[dim]];
          const at=sel.length?Math.max(...sel)+1:lst.length;
          pushUndo(); pasteAt(dim,at);
        } break;
      case 'g':
        if(SEL[dim].size&&isContiguousSel(dim)){ e.preventDefault(); pushUndo(); groupSelection(dim); } break;
      case 'd':
        e.preventDefault();
        SEL[dim].clear(); SEL_GROUPS[dim].clear(); renderSeq(dim); break;
    }
    return;
  }
  if (e.key==='Delete'||e.key==='Backspace') {
    if(SEL[dim].size||SEL_GROUPS[dim].size){ e.preventDefault(); pushUndo(); deleteSelection(dim); }
  }
  // ── Shift+N  →  select all rows with same thread count ──────
  if (e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'n') {
    e.preventDefault();
    const list = getList(dim);
    const selArr = [...SEL[dim]];
    if (!selArr.length) return;
    const refCount = list[selArr[0]]?.[1];
    if (refCount == null) return;
    SEL[dim].clear();
    list.forEach((row, idx) => { if (row[1] === refCount) SEL[dim].add(idx); });
    renderSeq(dim);
    return;
  }
  // ── Shift+C  →  select all rows with same color ─────────────
  if (e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'c') {
    e.preventDefault();
    const list = getList(dim);
    const selArr = [...SEL[dim]];
    if (!selArr.length) return;
    const refCi = list[selArr[0]]?.[0];
    if (refCi == null) return;
    SEL[dim].clear();
    list.forEach((row, idx) => { if (row[0] === refCi) SEL[dim].add(idx); });
    renderSeq(dim);
    return;
  }
});

// REPLACE the entire updateProgressBar() function
function updateProgressBar(barId, list, capacity, mirror, showRemaining = false) {
  const wrap = document.getElementById(barId + '-wrap');
  if (!wrap) return;
  if (capacity <= 0) { wrap.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  wrap.style.display = '';

  const track = wrap.querySelector('.thread-progress-track');
  const fill  = wrap.querySelector('.thread-progress-fill');
  const over  = wrap.querySelector('.thread-progress-over');
  const pctEl = wrap.querySelector('.pct');
  const right = wrap.querySelector('.progress-right');

  let bands = list.map(([ci, cnt]) => ({ hex: M.color(ci), cnt }));
  if (mirror) bands = [...[...bands].reverse(), ...bands];

  const used    = bands.reduce((s, b) => s + b.cnt, 0);
  const ratio   = Math.min(used / capacity, 1);
  const pctVal  = used / capacity * 100;

  const stops = [];
  let cursor = 0;
  for (const { hex, cnt } of bands) {
    if (used === 0) break;
    const s = (cursor / used) * ratio * 100;
    const e = Math.min(((cursor + cnt) / used) * ratio * 100, 100);
    if (s >= 100) break;
    stops.push(`${hex} ${s.toFixed(2)}%`, `${hex} ${e.toFixed(2)}%`);
    cursor += cnt;
  }

  if (stops.length) {
    fill.style.width      = (ratio * 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
    fill.style.background = `linear-gradient(to right,${stops.join(',')})`;
  } else {
    fill.style.width      = '0%';
    fill.style.background = 'transparent';
  }

  if (used > capacity) {
    const overW = ((used - capacity) / capacity * 100);
    over.style.width   = Math.min(overW, 100).toFixed(2) + '%';
    over.style.display = '';
  } else {
    over.style.display = 'none';
  }

  const rem = capacity - used;
  if (used === 0) {
    pctEl.textContent  = '0%';
    pctEl.className    = 'pct empty';
    right.textContent  = showRemaining
      ? `0 / ${capacity.toLocaleString()} · Rem: ${capacity.toLocaleString()}`
      : `0 / ${capacity.toLocaleString()}`;
  } else if (used > capacity) {
    pctEl.textContent  = pctVal.toFixed(0) + '% ⚠';
    pctEl.className    = 'pct over';
    right.textContent  = `+${(used - capacity).toLocaleString()} over`;
  } else if (used === capacity) {
    pctEl.textContent  = '100% ✓';
    pctEl.className    = 'pct full';
    right.textContent  = `${used.toLocaleString()} / ${capacity.toLocaleString()}`;
  } else {
    pctEl.textContent  = pctVal.toFixed(1) + '%';
    pctEl.className    = 'pct';
    right.textContent  = showRemaining
      ? `${used.toLocaleString()} / ${capacity.toLocaleString()} · Rem: ${rem.toLocaleString()}`
      : `${used.toLocaleString()} / ${capacity.toLocaleString()}`;
  }
}

// Pointer-centered zoom + drag-to-pan with proper viewport handling
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
let viewZoom        = 1.0;   // zoom factor (1.0 = show all threads)
let viewPanX        = 0;     // pan offset in warp-thread units
let viewPanY        = 0;     // pan offset in weft-row units
const ZOOM_MIN      = 1.0;   // minimum zoom
const ZOOM_MAX      = 80.0;  // maximum zoom
const ZOOM_STEP     = 0.15;  // zoom step per scroll event
const LOD_DETAIL_PX = 3.0;   // px/thread above which high-detail activates
const LOD_TRANS_LO  = 2.5;   // blend-zone start
const LOD_TRANS_HI  = 4.5;   // blend-zone end
let _zoomBadgeTimer = null;

function _showZoomBadge() {
  const badge = document.getElementById('zoomBadge');
  if (!badge) return;

  badge.classList.add('visible');

  _zoomBadgeTimer = setTimeout(() => badge.classList.remove('visible'), 1400);
}

// Pointer-centered zoom: the exact thread under pivotX stays at that screen pixel after zoom
function setZoom(z, pivotX) {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('canvasWrap');
  if (!wrap) return;
  const vc = document.getElementById('visCanvas');
  const W = vc?.width ?? (document.getElementById('previewArea').clientWidth - 48);
  const nW = Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById('totalWarpIn').value) || 5700);
  
  const prevPxT = (W / nW) * viewZoom;  // pixels per thread at current zoom
  const newZoom = Math.max(ZOOM_MIN, Math.min(ZOOM_MAX, z));
  const newPxT = (W / nW) * newZoom;    // pixels per thread at new zoom
  
  if (pivotX != null && newZoom !== viewZoom) {
    // Find which thread is at the pivot X position
    const pivotThread = viewPanX + pivotX / prevPxT;
    // Adjust pan so that thread stays at pivot X
    viewPanX = pivotThread - pivotX / newPxT;
  }
  
  viewZoom = newZoom;
  
  // Clamp pan to valid range: ensure we don't scroll past thread boundaries
  const visThreads = W / newPxT;
  viewPanX = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, nW - visThreads), viewPanX));
  
  _showZoomBadge();
  scheduleRedraw();
}

function resetZoom() {
  viewZoom = 1.0;
  viewPanX = 0;
  viewPanY = 0;
  _showZoomBadge();
  scheduleRedraw();
}

// ── Wheel zoom ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// FIND AND REPLACE the entire (function initZoomWheel() { ... })(); block:

(function initZoomAndPan() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('canvasWrap');
  if (!wrap) return;

  // Wheel: scroll always zooms (vertical) or pans (horizontal) — no Ctrl required
  wrap.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    const pivotX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    
    // Vertical scroll = zoom
    if (e.deltaY !== 0) {
      const dir = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1;
      setZoom(viewZoom * (1 + dir * ZOOM_STEP), pivotX);
    }
    // Horizontal scroll = pan (only if zoomed in)
    else if (e.deltaX !== 0 && viewZoom > 1) {
      const vc = document.getElementById('visCanvas');
      const nW = Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById('totalWarpIn').value) || 5700);
      const W = vc?.width ?? 800;
      const pxT = (W / nW) * viewZoom;
      const visThreads = W / pxT;
      const panDelta = e.deltaX / pxT;  // convert pixel scroll to thread units
      viewPanX = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, nW - visThreads), viewPanX + panDelta));
      scheduleRedraw();
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  // Double-click to reset zoom
  wrap.addEventListener('dblclick', e => {
    if (e.target.closest('.resize-handle')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    resetZoom();
  });
})();

// Drag-to-pan when zoomed in
(function initDragPan() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('canvasWrap');
  if (!wrap) return;
  
  let dragging = false;
  let dragStartX = 0, dragStartY = 0;
  let dragStartPanX = 0, dragStartPanY = 0;
  
  function startDrag(clientX, clientY) {
    if (viewZoom <= 1) return;  // Only pan when zoomed
    dragging = true;
    dragStartX = clientX; dragStartY = clientY;
    dragStartPanX = viewPanX; dragStartPanY = viewPanY;
    document.body.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
  }
  
  function updateDrag(clientX, clientY) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const vc = document.getElementById('visCanvas');
    const nW = Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById('totalWarpIn').value) || 5700);
    const W = vc?.width ?? 800;
    const H = vc?.height ?? 320;
    const fullWeft = expand(M.active_y(), false, 'y');
    const nH = fullWeft.length || 1;
    const pxT = (W / nW) * viewZoom;
    const pxR = pxT;  // pixel height per weft row
    
    // Horizontal pan
    const dx = clientX - dragStartX;
    const threadDelta = -dx / pxT;
    const visThreads = W / pxT;
    viewPanX = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, nW - visThreads), dragStartPanX + threadDelta));
    
    // Vertical pan
    const dy = clientY - dragStartY;
    const rowDelta = -dy / pxR;
    const visRows = H / pxR;
    viewPanY = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.max(0, nH - visRows), dragStartPanY + rowDelta));
    
    scheduleRedraw();
  }
  
  function stopDrag() {
    if (!dragging) return;
    dragging = false;
    document.body.style.cursor = '';
    document.body.style.userSelect = '';
  }
  
  wrap.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;  // left button only
    if (e.target.closest('.resize-handle')) return;  // don't interfere with height resize
    e.preventDefault();
    startDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    updateDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => stopDrag());
  
  // Touch support for single-finger drag-to-pan
  wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
    if (e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    if (e.target.closest('.resize-handle')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    startDrag(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
  }, { passive: false });
  
  wrap.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
    if (!dragging || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    updateDrag(e.touches[0].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY);
  }, { passive: false });
  
  wrap.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
    if (e.touches.length === 0) stopDrag();
  });
})();

// ── Pinch zoom (touch) ───────────────────────────────────────


(function initPinchZoom() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('canvasWrap');
  if (!wrap) return;
  let lastDist = null, lastMidX = 0;

  function td(t) {
    const dx = t[0].clientX - t[1].clientX, dy = t[0].clientY - t[1].clientY;
    return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  }

  wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
    if (e.touches.length === 2) {
      e.preventDefault();
      lastDist = td(e.touches);
      const r  = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      lastMidX = (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2 - r.left;
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  wrap.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
    if (e.touches.length === 2 && lastDist !== null) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const d    = td(e.touches);
      const r    = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
      const midX = (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2 - r.left;
      const zoomFactor = d / lastDist;  // ratio of new distance to old
      setZoom(viewZoom * zoomFactor, midX);  // zoom centered on midpoint
      lastDist = d; lastMidX = midX;
    }
  }, { passive: false });

  wrap.addEventListener('touchend', e => { if (e.touches.length < 2) lastDist = null; });

  let _lastTap = 0;
  wrap.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
    if (e.changedTouches.length === 1) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - _lastTap < 300) { e.preventDefault(); resetZoom(); }
      _lastTap = now;
    }
  });
})();
