    const raw = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return false;
    const data = JSON.parse(raw);
    M.colors = data.colors || M.colors;
    if (data.x_list)  { M.x_list  = data.x_list;  M.x_rowIds  = M.x_list.map(()=>newRowId());  M.x_groups  = data.x_groups  || []; }
    if (data.y_list)  { M.y_list  = data.y_list;  M.y_rowIds  = M.y_list.map(()=>newRowId());  M.y_groups  = data.y_groups  || []; }
    if (data.b_list)  { M.b_list  = data.b_list;  M.b_rowIds  = M.b_list.map(()=>newRowId());  M.b_groups  = data.b_groups  || []; }
    if (data.br_list) { M.br_list = data.br_list; M.br_rowIds = M.br_list.map(()=>newRowId()); M.br_groups = data.br_groups || []; }
    if (data.x_mirror !== undefined) document.getElementById('xMirror').checked = data.x_mirror;
    if (data.b_mirror !== undefined) document.getElementById('borderMirror').checked = data.b_mirror;
    if (data.twill)       document.getElementById('twillSel').value        = data.twill;
    if (data.canvasH)     document.getElementById('canvasH').value         = data.canvasH;
    if (data.totalBorder) document.getElementById('totalBorderIn').value = data.totalBorder;
    if (data.density) {
      document.getElementById('densityIn').value = data.density;
    }
    if (data.width) {
      document.getElementById('widthIn').value = data.width;
    }
    // Recalculate total after restoring density/width/border
    recalcThreadCount();
    if (data.projectName) {
      document.getElementById('projectNameIn').value = data.projectName;
      updateNavProjectName(data.projectName);
    }
    return true;
  } catch(e) { return false; }
}

function updateNavProjectName(name) {
  const wrap  = document.getElementById('navProjectName');
  const title = document.getElementById('navProjectTitle');
  if (!name || !name.trim()) {
    wrap.style.display = 'none'; return;
  }
  title.textContent  = name.trim();
  wrap.style.display = '';
}

// Debounced autosave
let _saveTimer = null;
function scheduleSave() {
  clearTimeout(_saveTimer);
  _saveTimer = setTimeout(saveState, 600);
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// THREAD COUNT CALCULATION  (Density × Width) + (Border × 2)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function recalcThreadCount() {
  const density    = Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById('densityIn').value)  || 100);
  const widthIn    = Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById('widthIn').value)    || 54);
  const borderPer  = Math.max(0, parseInt(document.getElementById('totalBorderIn').value) || 150);
  const total      = (density * widthIn) + (borderPer * 2);
  document.getElementById('totalWarpIn').value = total;
  const note = document.getElementById('totalWarpNote');
  if (note) note.textContent = total.toLocaleString() + ' threads';
  return total;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BOOTSTRAP
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
initTheme();

M.colors   = ['#000000', '#00ADC4', '#FFFFFF'];
M.x_list   = [[3,100],[1,30],[3,30]];
M.y_list   = [[3,100],[1,30],[3,30]];
M.b_list   = [[1,60],[3,40]];
M.br_list  = [[1,60],[3,40]];
M.x_mirror = true;
M.y_mirror = false;

// Initialise parallel rowId arrays
M.x_rowIds  = M.x_list.map(()=>newRowId());
M.y_rowIds  = M.y_list.map(()=>newRowId());
M.b_rowIds  = M.b_list.map(()=>newRowId());
M.br_rowIds = M.br_list.map(()=>newRowId());
M.x_groups  = []; M.y_groups  = []; M.b_groups  = []; M.br_groups = [];
M.x_hidden  = new Set(); M.y_hidden  = new Set();
M.b_hidden  = new Set(); M.br_hidden = new Set();

document.getElementById('xMirror').checked     = true;
document.getElementById('borderMirror').checked = true;

// Set initial calculated warp
recalcThreadCount();

// Attempt to restore saved state
const didLoad = loadState();

renderPalette();
renderSeq('x');
renderWeftPanel();
renderBorderPanel();
updateTotal('y');
updateTotal('b');
updateTotal('x');
scheduleRedraw();
requestAnimationFrame(() => applyZoom());

// ── Density / Width input listeners ─────────────────────────
['densityIn', 'widthIn'].forEach(id => {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) {
    el.addEventListener('input', () => {
      // Enforce max limits
      if (id === 'densityIn' && el.value > 300) el.value = 300;
      if (id === 'widthIn' && el.value > 100) el.value = 100;
      
      recalcThreadCount();
      updateTotal('b');
      renderBorderPanel();
      renderSeq('x');
      displayValidationErrors();
      scheduleRedraw();
      scheduleSave();
    });
  }
});

// ── Canvas Height input listener ────────────────────────────
document.getElementById('canvasH')?.addEventListener('input', function() {
  // Enforce max limit
  if (this.value > 800) this.value = 800;
  displayValidationErrors();
  scheduleRedraw();
});

// ── Warp/Weft/Border row change listener ────────────────────
// This watches for changes to seq-n inputs (band thread counts)
(function initRowValidation() {
  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    displayValidationErrors();
  });
  
  ['xRows', 'yRows', 'bRows', 'bRowsLeft', 'bRowsRight'].forEach(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) {
      observer.observe(el, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      // Also listen for input on existing .seq-n elements
      el.querySelectorAll('.seq-n').forEach(inp => {
        inp.addEventListener('input', () => {
          displayValidationErrors();
        });
      });
    }
  });
})();

// ── Border mirror toggle ─────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById('borderMirror').addEventListener('change', () => {
  renderBorderPanel();
  scheduleRedraw();
  scheduleSave();
});

// ── Project name ─────────────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById('projectNameIn').addEventListener('input', e => {
  updateNavProjectName(e.target.value);
  scheduleSave();
});

// ── Wire all other inputs to autosave ────────────────────────
['twillSel','canvasH','totalBorderIn','xMirror'].forEach(id => {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.addEventListener('change', scheduleSave);
  if (el) el.addEventListener('input',  scheduleSave);
});

// Set activeDim when hovering a panel section
[['x','secWarp'],['y','secWeft'],['b','secBorder']].forEach(([dim,sid])=>{
  const el=document.getElementById(sid);
  if(el) el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>setActiveDim(dim));
});

// ── Theme toggle ────────────────────────────────────────────
document.getElementById('themeToggle').addEventListener('click', toggleTheme);

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MOBILE TAB BAR
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
let activeMobTab = null;

function activateMobileTab(secId, tabId) {
  const sidebar = document.querySelector('.sidebar');
  const isSame  = activeMobTab === tabId;

  document.querySelectorAll('.mob-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.sec').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('mobile-active'));
  activeMobTab = null;

  if (isSame) {
    sidebar.classList.remove('mobile-open');
    return;
  }

  const target = document.getElementById(secId);
  if (target) target.classList.add('mobile-active');

  sidebar.scrollTop = 0;
  sidebar.classList.add('mobile-open');

  const tabEl = document.getElementById(tabId);
  if (tabEl) tabEl.classList.add('active');
  activeMobTab = tabId;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// NUMBER INPUT SCRUBBER  —  Figma / Photoshop style
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Click-drag LEFT/RIGHT on any number input to decrease/increase.
//   Default  →  1× step per pixel
//   Shift    → 10× step per pixel  (coarse jumps)
//   Alt/Opt  →  0.1× step per pixel  (fine tuning)
//
// A plain click (no drag) focuses & selects the field as normal.
// Dynamically-added inputs (seq rows) are auto-attached via
// MutationObserver so every number input gets scrub support.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
(function initScrubbers() {
  'use strict';

  let state = null; // active scrub session data

  function onMouseDown(e) {
    if (e.button !== 0) return; // left-click only
    // Don't capture on resize handle (ns-resize) - handled separately
    const inp  = e.currentTarget;
    const step = parseFloat(inp.step) || 1;
    const min  = parseFloat(inp.min);
    const max  = parseFloat(inp.max);
    state = {
      inp,
      startX   : e.clientX,
      startVal : parseFloat(inp.value) || 0,
      step,
      min : isNaN(min) ? -Infinity : min,
      max : isNaN(max) ?  Infinity : max,
      moved    : false,
      scrubbing: false,
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup',   onMouseUp);
  }

  function onMouseMove(e) {
    if (!state) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - state.startX;

    // Activate only after 3px horizontal movement — avoids misfires on sloppy clicks
    if (!state.scrubbing && Math.abs(dx) > 3) {
      state.scrubbing = true;
      state.moved     = true;
      document.body.style.cursor     = 'ew-resize';
      document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';
      // Blur so we don't accidentally edit text while dragging
      state.inp.blur();
    }

    if (state.scrubbing) {
      e.preventDefault();
      // Speed modifiers
      const mult    = e.shiftKey ? 10 : e.altKey ? 0.1 : 1;
      // Raw value: startVal + pixels × step × multiplier
      const rawVal  = state.startVal + dx * state.step * mult;
      // Snap to step grid
      const snapped = Math.round(rawVal / state.step) * state.step;
      // Clamp to [min, max]
      const newVal  = Math.max(state.min, Math.min(state.max, snapped));
      // Only fire 'input' event if value actually changed (avoids needless redraws)
      if (parseFloat(state.inp.value) !== newVal) {
        state.inp.value = newVal;
        state.inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
      }
    }
  }

  function onMouseUp() {
    if (!state) return;
    document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    document.removeEventListener('mouseup',   onMouseUp);
    document.body.style.cursor     = '';
    document.body.style.userSelect = '';

    if (!state.moved) {
      // Pure click — let the browser focus + select-all the field
      state.inp.focus();
      state.inp.select();
    }
    state = null;
  }

  function attach(inp) {
    if (inp._scrubAttached) return; // idempotent
    inp._scrubAttached = true;
    inp.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
  }

  // Attach to all number inputs present at init time
  document.querySelectorAll('input[type=number]').forEach(attach);

  // Auto-attach to number inputs added later (seq rows are created dynamically)
  new MutationObserver(mutations => {
    for (const m of mutations) {
      m.addedNodes.forEach(node => {
        if (node.nodeType !== 1) return;
        if (node.matches?.('input[type=number]')) attach(node);
        node.querySelectorAll?.('input[type=number]').forEach(attach);
      });
    }
  }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
})();
</script>
